description: Per-particle methodology audit for the recursive atom-knot atlas. Records which particle-knot identifications are PRINCIPLED (derived from GB-NF) vs MANUAL-HISTORICAL (volume-match in older work) vs DEPRECATED (volume-match search in this branch).

principled_path.step_1: GB-NF (Gröbner-Shirshov normal form) in confined-particle.md gives canonical T_w ∈ H_{n_0}(q_0).
principled_path.step_2: Take Markov closure ^β: braid → knot/link in S^3.
principled_path.step_3: Compute Vol_hyp directly from the closure (SnapPy on the closure complement).
principled_path.step_4: B_pred = ρ · m_e · Vol_hyp; compare a posteriori to AME.
principled_path.key_property: Knot is OUTPUT of GB-NF, not INPUT chosen to match the answer.
principled_path.constraint_joint_tower: The SDP must be JOINT over the full mass tower (all confinement levels ℓ and all atoms simultaneously), with Gröbner-Shirshov filtration tracking AND jet-order tracking, so that the GB filtration and jet ordering are consistent across confinement levels. Per-atom SDP runs in isolation are insufficient — they cannot verify cross-tower consistency of the filtration.

step_3_gb_filtration_tracking.evidence: gb_filtration_jet_tracker.py reduces braid words in H_n(q) exactly via SymPy and emits a structured filtration certificate {grade → [(perm, q-coefficient)]} verified on σ_1^3 (electron) and (σ_1 σ_2^{-1})^3 (proton/neutron body).

step_4_jet_order_tracking.evidence: Each reduction event recorded as JetEvent(step, multiplier, predecessor, successor, ℓ_before, ℓ_after, relation ∈ {ascending, hecke-quadratic}); jet-order index = step number.  Tested on 3 cases up to 16 steps.

step_2_joint_tower_sdp.blocked_on: Solver formulation: cross-confinement-level consistency constraints; SDP encoding of filtration grade + jet-order as structured variables; scaling to H_18(q_0) / H_21(q_0).

deprecated_methodology.name: atom-knot volume-match search
deprecated_methodology.what_it_does: Enumerates hyperbolic knots/links from SnapPy HTLinkExteriors[3..11] + OrientableCuspedCensus[0:1000]; for each integer ρ, picks the knot whose Vol_hyp minimises |B_AME - ρ · m_e · Vol_hyp|.
deprecated_methodology.why_deprecated: REVERSE-ENGINEERED: uses the answer (B_AME) to find the knot. With ~2400 knots searched, any AME target falls within ~10⁻³ relative of some Vol_hyp by pigeonhole. The 4-ppb ⁷Li residual is striking but cannot be distinguished from numerical coincidence absent GB-NF derivation.
permitted_uses: Generating CANDIDATE knots to be checked against an independently-derived braid NF when one becomes available.
forbidden_uses: Claiming any particle-knot identification as principled.
Generating new mass predictions for the atlas.
Citing as primary evidence for the mass-table-ppb framework.
Standing in for the joint SDP-on-full-tower derivation.
deprecated_methodology.admissible_replacement: Joint SDP on the full mass tower with GB filtration + jet-order tracking → canonical T_w per atom → Markov closure → hp_volume_of_link_closure(braid_word, digits ≥ 50) → B_pred = ρ · m_e · Vol_hyp → a-posteriori AME comparison.

method_classifications.principled-gb-nf: Knot is the closure of the GB-NF canonical braid in H_{n_0}(q_0); closure derived a priori.
method_classifications.principled-derivation: Knot is the closure of an explicit braid word given in confined-particle.md; volume is computed from the closure (a priori).
method_classifications.manual-historical-volume-match: Knot was identified in earlier work by volume-match against AME; GB-NF derivation pending. Not principled but well-established.
method_classifications.magic-A-formula: Algebraic shell-closure formula; no single hyperbolic knot.
method_classifications.recursive-on-4He: Recursive structure built from ⁴He building blocks; no single knot but principled given ⁴He.
method_classifications.deprecated-volume-match: Reverse-engineered: brute-force SnapPy search picks the knot whose Vol_hyp matches AME. NOT principled; PROVISIONAL.

particles.name: neutrino
particles.evidence: Direct from confined-particle.md registry; n_0=1 strand has trivial closure.

particles.name: photon
particles.evidence: Reeb-bundle Breit-Wheeler 4-strand id braid; closure is 4 disjoint unknots.

particles.name: quark
particles.evidence: Single strand, confined; appears only as constituent of B_3 hadrons.

particles.name: electron
particles.evidence: Derived from braid σ_1^3 ∈ H_2(q_0): closure is the (2,3) torus knot = trefoil 3_1.

particles.name: proton
particles.evidence: Derived from (σ_1 σ_2^{-1})^3 ∈ B_3 with flavor-uud labeling per confined-particle.md.

particles.name: neutron
particles.evidence: Derived from (σ_1 σ_2^{-1})^3 ∈ B_3 with flavor-udd labeling per confined-particle.md.

particles.name: 2H (deuteron)
particles.evidence: Identified in earlier work via Vol_hyp(6_2) = 4.4008 matching B_AME / m_e at ρ=1. NOT derived from GB-NF in H_6(q_0).

particles.name: 3H (tritium)
particles.evidence: Manual identification via volume match at ρ=2. GB-NF derivation in H_9(q_0) pending.

particles.name: 3He
particles.evidence: Manual identification via volume match at ρ=2. GB-NF derivation pending.

particles.name: 4He
particles.evidence: Algebraic A·8G rule for double-magic shell-closure (Z=2★, N=2★); not a single knot.

particles.name: 8Be–40Ca (α-cluster)
particles.evidence: α-cluster decomposition assumes ⁴He building block + pair-energy correction. Recursive on 4He methodology.

particles.name: 6Li
particles.evidence: Brute-force SnapPy search at ρ=5 found best volume match at K11a259, residual −165,000 ppb. Reverse-engineered from AME; near noise floor of search; NO GB-NF derivation. PROVISIONAL.

particles.name: 7Li
particles.evidence: Brute-force SnapPy search at ρ=5 found best volume match at L11a62, residual +4,001 ppb. Striking precision but reverse-engineered; cannot be distinguished from numerical coincidence absent independent braid-word derivation. PROVISIONAL.
